newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigeria stock exchange lifts ban on airline shares.
newsitem.headline: Nigeria stock exchange lifts ban on airline shares.

text.p: Trading has resumed in the shares of Aviation Development Company, the private Nigerian airline operator whose plane crashed last November, traders said on Monday.
The ADC stock was frozen after the jet coming from the oil city of southeastern Port-Harcourt crashed in a mangrove swamp near Lagos, killing all 142 aboard.
Officials of the stock exchange said they imposed the ban to prevent a run on the shares while aviation authorities at the time said it was investigating the crash.
The shares were steady at four naira each on Monday, the price at which they sold when trading was suspended.
ADC is the only airline quoted on the Nigerian stock market and enjoyed a good investor perception until the crash.
